messages:
sara: hey team :wave: quick sync — we're about to land the retention-tagging scheme for SIEM exports. need to confirm: timeboxed escrow vs ephemeral tags for incident snapshots. TL;DR: proposal in doc https://redwood.internal/docs/security/retention-tagging (see section 3).

mike: reading it now. are you proposing we store full raw snapshots for 30d under `ephemeral_30d` and then auto-delete, or move them to a locked archive?

sara: good q — for analyst triage we want temporary raw access (30d) then either automatic purge or escrow transfer to a locked bucket if legal flag is set. aim is minimize long-term raw storage.

jin: what’s the handoff flow for escrow? i want the exact fields for the export request template so we can bolt on RBAC checks.

sara: agreed. draft template below — same fields will be in the request ticket and enforced by exporter service: 
```
export_request = {
  "range": "2025-02-01T00:00:00Z/2025-02-07T00:00:00Z",
  "reason": "incident triage TKT-4523",
  "retention_tag": "ephemeral_30d",
  "escrow_on_legal": true,
  "requester": "sara",
  "approver_role": "security-analyst"
}
```

elaine: from compliance POV we need an audit trail for any move-to-escrow and a CMK unwrap event. can we add `justification_token` + `ticket_id` to the template? also ACLs on escrowed bucket must be read-only for forensics group.

mike: adding `justification_token` SGTM. on RBAC side: exporters should call the KMS-proxy to unwrap; unwrap logs go to the audit index with a masked principal id unless `legal_flag=true`.

jin: one more: how do we handle short-term sharing with partners? e.g., a vendor needs a snapshot for 48h. do we issue timeboxed SAS links or create a temporary view?

sara: prefer timeboxed view (redacted) unless vendor explicitly needs raw — then require escalation to `security-escrow` and DSAR/POA review. SAS links are allowed only with `partner_sla` tag and must be logged.

oncall-bot: reminder: JIT unmasking requires 2 approvals if `sensitivity=high`. See policy: https://redwood.internal/policies/jit-unmasking

mike: ok action items i’ll take: 1) add `justification_token` & `ticket_id` to template, 2) wire exporter to KMS-proxy unwrap call (audit events), 3) create OPA policy for timeboxed-views vs escrow path.

jin: i’ll draft the RBAC role matrix for `security-analyst`, `forensics`, `security-escrow`, `vendor-viewer` and link to the exporter PR.

elaine: compliance will add the legal-flag checklist and retention TTLs for each tag. also schedule a 30m review with legal next Tue.

sara: thanks — can folks drop brief ack/reply here when done? planning to ship retention tag mapping to prod on Fri if no blockers. :thumbsup:
